system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Generate a Kubernetes Service manifest exposing a 'web-frontend' Deployment via a LoadBalancer for external HTTP/HTTPS traffic.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Generate a Kubernetes Service manifest exposing a 'web-frontend' Deployment via a LoadBalancer for external HTTP/HTTPS traffic.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web-frontend
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: web-frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: web
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: kubectl
  annotations:
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: "nlb"
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-scheme: "internet-facing"
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-cross-zone-load-balancing-enabled: "true"
    service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-backend-protocol: "tcp"
    cloud.google.com/load-balancer-type: "External"
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  externalTrafficPolicy: Local
  sessionAffinity: None
  ipFamilyPolicy: SingleStack
  ipFamilies:
    - IPv4
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: web-frontend
  ports:
    - name: http
      protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: http
    - name: https
      protocol: TCP
      port: 443
      targetPort: https
  loadBalancerSourceRanges:
    - 0.0.0.0/0
